scopeChange: User removed real-hardware and human-playtesting release requirements on 2026-10-16. Other adopted requirements remain required.

stages.local: Required before package creation or any staging writes
stages.staged: Required before conditional root promotion; includes disposable provider verification
stages.live: Required after promotion before claiming deployment verified

required.outcome: Fresh player loads, learns the controls, starts and finishes Yard Loop without an account
required.method: Browser journey with retained evidence

required.outcome: Player pauses, opens settings, returns, resumes and immediately steers without a focus/input surprise
required.method: Keyboard-only and injected gamepad/touch browser checks

required.outcome: Player completes a three-race cup, reloads between rounds, and keeps exactly one set of rewards
required.method: Storage transaction assertions and UI journey

required.outcome: Player completes all twelve events with ordinary inputs/resources and sees the held final scene
required.method: Continuous persisted seeded campaigns; no forced finish fixture as a substitute

required.outcome: Player compares and equips a part, tests it and can explain its tradeoff
required.method: Bench measurements and matching garage descriptions

required.outcome: Player finishes a Time Trial, sees correct lap arithmetic, races a compatible ghost and improves a best
required.method: Independent timing fixtures and UI journey

required.outcome: Player starts before UTC midnight, finishes after it, uploads later and remains on the original challenge
required.method: Injected calendar/network boundaries and recorded challenge identity

required.outcome: New creator builds a closed circuit, corrects a gap, places gates and drives a valid lap
required.method: Pointer, keyboard/list and emulated touch workflows

required.outcome: Creator tests against five AI, returns to exact editor context, undoes, reloads and recovers work
required.method: UI plus stored-revision assertions

required.outcome: Creator exports, imports and gets identical gameplay meaning without executing hostile content
required.method: Canonical round trip and adversarial inert-import fixtures

required.outcome: Two owner editors conflict; stale editor preserves work and never overwrites the newer track
required.method: Disposable real provider document with conditional writes

required.outcome: Published track succeeds but catalog update conflicts; exact link works and listing retry is safe
required.method: Provider fault fixture and readback

required.outcome: Existing release discovers a new version naturally and updates between runs without losing state

required.outcome: Score submission times out after server acceptance; original ID reconciles once across two tabs
